decision: Work kind = change behavior (greenfield plugin)
why: Empty project dir, new build requested
evidence: ls of cwd shows only .crush

decision: Split: Go helper does GitHub I/O, QML renders JSON
why: Matches omarchy.agents/omarchy.weather collector pattern; develop.html forbids a 2nd Quickshell
evidence: shell/plugins/agents/Main.qml runs omarchy-agent-usage-update via Process

decision: Enumerate repos then query per-repo runs
why: /orgs/{org}/actions/runs returns 404 even for a member org with read:org/repo/workflow scopes
evidence: gh api /orgs/<member-org>/actions/runs -> 404; /repos/{o}/{r}/actions/runs -> 200

decision: Delegate auth/transport to installed gh CLI
why: Avoids storing tokens; gh already authenticated via keyring
evidence: gh auth status -> Logged in (keyring)

decision: Go stdlib only, no external modules
why: Keeps go build offline and dependency-free
evidence: go.mod has no require block

decision: Helper always exits 0, errors go in JSON .error
why: Panel can render a message instead of failing silently
evidence: -bad account -> JSON error, exit=0

decision: qmllint is non-gating in this environment
why: Documented qmllint -I $OMARCHY_PATH/shell exits 255 with no output even on first-party clock plugin
evidence: qmllint on plugins/panels/clock/BarWidget.qml -> exit 255

decision: Live-shell load is the authoritative QML check
why: Shell reload + qs log surfaces real runtime errors
evidence: install -> rescan -> summon -> qs log shows our module errors

decision: Panel.qml row height bound to undefined id titleRow
why: Delegate threw ReferenceError: titleRow is not defined at Panel.qml[117:17]
evidence: qs log WARN ReferenceError titleRow (30+ hits)

decision: Red-green proof of the delegate fix
why: Mock helper forces rows so the delegate instantiates deterministically
evidence: buggy file delta=+4 titleRow errors; fixed file post shell-restart delta=0

decision: Shell restart required to load changed QML
why: rescanPlugins/cache-clear did not swap the already-instantiated component
evidence: titleRow errors persisted with a titleRow-free file until omarchy restart shell
result: New pid loaded fixed file, 0 errors

decision: Confirmed widget is live and polling
why: Call-logging mock proved the Process runs the helper
evidence: /tmp/ghwatch-mock.called: called args=-max-repos 60

decision: Skip PR
why: No git remote configured and global rules forbid commit/push without explicit request
evidence: git init done locally, no remote; user did not ask to commit
result: Left work in tree, installed and verified

decision: Work kind = reshape (PII audit + UI redesign)
why: Follow-up request on the built plugin
evidence: user request

decision: PII/secrets audit of the tree
why: Directory will become a public repo
evidence: rg for tokens/emails/home-paths/org names/IPs across tracked files
result: No secrets; .crush/ and bin/ git-ignored; only source would commit

decision: Genericize a real org name in docs
why: Org membership is sensitive for a public repo
evidence: DECISIONS.tsv + README referenced a member org

decision: Keep author GitHub handle in id/module/author
why: Omarchy requires io.github.<user>.* ids; handle is public, not secret
evidence: develop.html namespacing rule; 16 structural occurrences
result: Kept; documented how to rename in README

decision: Redesign panel: spacious + Charm/TUI + progress visuals
why: User asked for spacious UI, visuals over text, charm look
evidence: Panel.qml rewritten; width 460, spacing 16, cards, chips

decision: Draw meters with Rectangles, not block glyphs
why: Block/braille glyph coverage varies by font; tofu risk
evidence: gauge + activity bars built from Rectangle cells/fills

decision: Only the running/queued gauge is determinate
why: Active-run API record has no total duration, so no honest per-run %
evidence: / actions/runs fields lack a duration total
result: Per-run bars are indeterminate sweep/pulse; documented

decision: Reload new QML via shell restart, then render both states
why: Changed QML does not hot-swap in a running shell
evidence: omarchy restart shell -> new pid; summon populated(mock)+empty(real)
result: 0 warnings/errors for the plugin; helper invoked
